headword: {精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}

definitions.explanation: A boxed meal prepared entirely from plant-based ingredients following the principles of shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine), without meat, fish, or strong-smelling vegetables like garlic and onion.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I had a vegetarian bento at the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅弁|えきべん}→駅弁：09702_ekiben⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are vegetarian bentos among the station box lunches too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩り：12506_irodori⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な{精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧ほど⟦{満足感|まんぞくかん}→満足感：15988_manzokukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A colorful vegetarian bento is so satisfying you wouldn't believe it's made entirely from vegetables.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{精進|しょうじん}→精進：13788_shoujin⟧ (Buddhist devotion; abstinence from meat) and ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (boxed meal). This is the bento version of ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧ (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine), a culinary tradition with roots in Zen Buddhism that has become popular beyond religious contexts.

- {精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to reserve a vegetarian bento
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}: seasonal vegetarian bento
- {精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧{拝観|はいかん}: temple visit with a vegetarian bento included

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many famous temples in Kyoto and Kamakura offer {精進弁当|しょうじんべんとう} to visitors. Unlike Western vegetarian food, traditional ⟦{精進|しょうじん}→精進：13788_shoujin⟧ cooking also avoids the five pungent roots ({五葷|ごくん}: garlic, onion, leek, chive, and rakkyo). The meals typically feature seasonal vegetables, tofu, and seaweed.
